guidance.claim: Management anticipates mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
guidance.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: The gap between volume and value will remain in the 4-5% zone.
guidance.quote: And therefore, we would anticipate that the gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: Management maintains the guidance for an 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.
guidance.quote: Given all this, it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Delivered a volume growth of 10.9% in Q2FY26.
reported.quote: If you look from the point of view of performance, we delivered a volume growth of 10.9% in Q2FY26, but we had a value of about 6% in an environment which was not too great and overall consumer sentiment sentiments were also not too great.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: In H1, volume growth is at 7.2% and value growth at 2.1%.
reported.quote: In H1, we are at 7.2% volume and 2.1% value growth, which I think in the current circumstances it is good.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Gross margins are up to 43.7%, higher by 270 bps year-over-year.
reported.quote: We are up from 43.2% in last quarter to about 43.7% now. At the same time, we are up 270 bps from same quarter last year.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Standalone Net Sales grew by 5.8% and Gross Margins expanded by 270bps.
reported.quote: So, finally coming to the overall standalone financials, Net Sales as I said grew by 5.8%, Gross Margins have expanded by 270bps to 43.7%.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Standalone PBDIT grew by 21% with margin at 18.5%.
reported.quote: PBDIT has grown by 21% and PBDIT margin is at 18.5% higher by 230bps points.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
